subject: soc-rt
title: SOC.RT.------POL.P.
description: Second diagram on page 251 (PR.S(RD)II-5), paired with CULT-AF-B x POL-P above. The crossing diagrams how social-reality structurally meets political-policies: SOC-RT crossed with POL-P. SOC-RT sits at left with the subject-arrow; POL-P at center-right as partner-axis. SOC-RT-P (social-reality particular) branches up from the main line; it carries RT-ALGN (reality alignment), which carries CULT-SOLD (culture solidification), and TRS (transition), which carries T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), which carries STF (source transfer). IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) branches down to the right and carries EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) and PART (participation), which carries INFO-COMP (information compression). INFO-ALGN (information alignment) branches down to the left and carries VT-PLT (vibrational platform), which carries CN-INFO (controlled information) and VT-SY.
